war.speech: In 2026, chemical warfare caused the release of a zombie virus.

famine.speech: The outbreak spread, bringing famine and a devastating decline in population.

depots.speech: To protect the remaining population, the government has built food depots, armories, and other emergency facilities.

stay-home.speech: All residents are urged to remain at home. Do not go outside.

resolve.speech: Ugh... I have to do something.

camp.speech: To all survivors: please make your way to the nearest survivor camp.
